get.summary:
Returns the runtime config verbatim; the FE reads it once at startup. Infallible (an in-memory
clone), so it returns `Response` directly rather than `ApiResult`.
The roster of active makers, each with its position count and shared liquidity.

One maker's dashboard (KPIs, fill-share, latency, insight). `{maker}` is an address (`me` needs a
wallet).
A maker's inventory: its positions re-grouped by token (the Assets tab). `{maker}` is an address.
A maker's active positions (list projection). `{maker}` is an address (`me` needs a wallet).
A maker's settlements (newest first, cursor-paginated) — its trades with per-trade share and fee.

post.summary:
Submit a taker-signed order: decode → verify the swapper signature → cosign → route → reserve →
persist → fill. A malformed or unverifiable order is `400`; an unroutable one returns a
`declined` trade (`200`).

Route `amount_in` of `token_in` into `token_out`, returning the split and its impact. `422` when
no route exists (no makers, or the size is beyond the book).

422.description: No route for the pair and size

get.summary: List trades, newest first, filtered and cursor-paginated.
One trade's full detail, or `404` if the id is unknown.
Balances for `addr` over every catalog token. A malformed address → `400`.

ActiveStats.description: Recent-activity stats for the position detail.

daily_fills.description: Seven daily confirmed-order counts, oldest first.

ActivityEvent.description: One Aqua event on the feed. `token` is present only for the balance-moving kinds (push / pull).

at.description: Unix seconds the event was recorded.

Amount.description:
A token amount: `raw` base units (never a float), a human-formatted `display`, and `usd` (`None`
until pricing is wired).

AmountIn.description: One leg of a ship: a token and the amount in base units (a decimal integer string).

AppConfig.description: Runtime config the FE reads instead of hardcoding — also the `/config` response body.

app.description: The application whose strategies Aqua scopes independently.

aqua.description: The Aqua deployment holding maker virtual balances.

cosigner.description: The resolver authorized to cosign taker orders.

filler.description: The public executor target for encoded rebate transactions.

permit2.description: The Permit2 contract verifying the taker witness.

reactor.description: The UniswapX reactor that settles taker orders.

taker_credential.description: The immutable token whose balance gates every strategy to the filler contract.

Asset.description:
The complete picture of one asset: identity + static metadata + market + protocol status. Every
asset query returns this, and the API serializes it verbatim.

price_usd.description: USD price and its 24h change — `None` until the price feed is wired.

supported.description: Whether ≥1 active strategy quotes this asset, how many, and the pairs it trades in.

CurveMix.description:
How many of a pool's active makers price on each curve shape. A pool commonly mixes shapes,
so this is a census rather than a single label.

DepthPoint.description:
One point on the depth curve, anchored to a price-impact bucket. Amounts are base-unit strings;
`impact_pct` is how far `effective_price` sits below `best_price`, in percent.

Economics.description: USD economics for a position over the dashboard's window.

Features.description: Feature flags the FE reads at bootstrap. `earn` / `send_buy` are always off in the MVP.

FillShare.description: The maker's fills as a share of all fills on the pairs it quotes.

filled.description: The maker's confirmed fills in the window.

pair_fills.description: All confirmed fills on the maker's pairs in the window (the share denominator).

InventoryLeg.description:
One position's slice of a token: this token's committed vs opening balance in that position, plus
the position's economics (repeated per leg).

current.description: This token's committed balance in the position.

opening.description: This token's ship-time balance in the position.

InventoryRow.description:
One token in a maker's inventory: its wallet vs committed balances, aggregate economics, and the
positions (`legs`) that hold it. The maker's positions re-grouped by token (the Assets tab).

fees_usd.description: Fees from every position holding this token (a position counts under each token it holds).

shared.description: Committed across all the maker's positions.

wallet.description: The maker's wallet balance of this token (uncapped).

MakerActivityBucket.description: A time bucket of confirmed orders. Latency runs from order creation to confirmation.

latency_p50_ms.description: Milliseconds, with the source timestamps' one-second precision; null for an empty bucket.

MakerDashboard.description:
A maker's dashboard: headline KPIs (with period-over-period deltas), fill-share on the pairs it
quotes, fill latency, and a competitive insight. USD values are `None` when unpriced.

insight.description: A cheaper competitor on one of the maker's pairs, if any undercuts it.

window_days.description: The window (days) the KPIs and deltas cover.

MakerKpis.description: The dashboard KPI tiles. `*_change_pct` are period-over-period deltas (previous equal window).

shared_liq_ratio.description: Pullable ÷ shared liquidity — aggregate backing coverage, rendered "×".

MakerLeg.description: One maker's slice of the routed split, on the wire.

MakerPeriod.description: Rolling analytics windows used by the maker dashboard's period controls.

fee_usd.description: The maker's captured fee, valued at the trade-time prices — settled trades only.

share_pct.description: The maker's slice of the trade (delivered ÷ total) — settled trades only.

MakerTrade.description: A settlement in a maker's feed: the trade header plus the maker's share and captured fee.

indicative_in.description: What sourcing the delivery would cost us, once routing priced it.

reason.description: The admission rule that refused it.

required_out.description: What the settler demands, priced when the order was seen.

source.description:
Where it came from: `uniswapx` (the public book), `oneinch` (the public book), or `solvent`
(our own endpoint).

trade_decline_reason.description: Why the trade declined — the sim gate's real on-chain revert reason, or the margin call.

trade_id.description: The trade's own id — what the explorer links to for the trade's full detail.

trade_status.description:
The trade this order became, if it was ever attempted — absent when it was refused at the
door or declined as unprofitable before routing ever reserved anything.

total.description: How many orders the feed has ever shown us — the denominator this page sits inside.

PairInfo.description:
One tradeable pair offered by the Create wizard: the two tokens, their kind, mid price, the
suggested defaults, and (when a wallet is supplied) the maker's balance of each side.

mid.description: Mid price, quote per 1 base — `None` when either side is unpriced.

type.description: `stable` when both sides are stablecoins, else `volatile`.

oneOf.description: The maker's wallet balance of each side; present only when a wallet was supplied.

PairKind.description: Whether a pair is stable/stable or involves a volatile asset — drives the wizard's default curve.

PairPriceHistory.description: Historical market data for one oriented pair.

PairPricePoint.description: One timestamped pair midpoint, quoted as `quote` per one `base`.

volume_usd.description: USD-denominated market volume for the interval when the source provides it.

PairWallet.description: A maker's wallet balance of each side of a pair, as display numbers and exact base units.

Pool.description:
A pool: the aggregation of all active, priceable strategies over one canonical pair. USD and
volume/fills fields are absent/zero until their data sources (pricing, the trade store) exist.

tvl_change_24h_pct.description:
How the pool's holdings moved with the market over 24h, value-weighted across its tokens.
Prices only — a ship or a dock changes the pool's value without appearing here.

PoolDepth.description:
The pool's combined executable liquidity as a curve: for each sampled trade size, the output, its
blended price, and how far that price sits below the tip. Reconstructs an order book the pool
doesn't have by stacking every active maker's curve (the router's split, plotted across sizes).

PoolDetail.description:
Pool detail: the list row plus the maker roster. The roster is the only field the detail view
adds over [`Pool`], so it composes one rather than restating every KPI. Depth/price-impact and
recent fills join as their sources land.

PoolMaker.description:
One maker's strategy in a pool: curve, fee, and committed (`virtual`) balances. Actual/pullable
(on-chain) balances and uptime are absent until the balance reader and metrics capture exist.

oneOf.description:
What the maker could actually deliver now — the committed amount capped by what Aqua may
pull. `None` when the chain read failed, which is not the same as nothing being pullable.

PoolType.description: How a pool's makers price the pair — drives filtering and display.

Position.description: A maker's position — one shipped strategy, valued and analyzed.

mid_price.description: Fee-free marginal price in human quote units per base unit.

PositionBalances.description: Committed, pullable and initial ship balances for a position.

backed.description: Whether every committed token is fully pullable on-chain (no `shortfall`).

coverage.description: Pullable USD as a fraction of committed USD (`1.0` = fully backed).

PositionHistory.description: Committed-reserve price history over the last seven days, with transaction-final samples.

PreviewRequest.description: The SDK-encoded strategy and the amounts the maker intends to ship, keyed to a wallet.

PreviewResponse.description:
Server-authoritative pre-flight for a ship the SDK already encoded: whether the strategy
already exists, which tokens still need an approval, and any warnings.

exists.description: A strategy with this hash already exists — a re-ship would collide.

requires_approval.description: Tokens whose allowance to Aqua is below the amount to ship; approve them first.

warnings.description: Human warnings, e.g. insufficient balance for a leg.

PriceHistoryPeriod.description: The history window requested by a price chart.

PriceRange.description: A position's price range in human `quote per base` terms; which fields are set depends on `kind`.

QuoteLeg.description: One maker's slice of a quoted route.

share_pct.description: This leg's share of the blended output, in percent.

QuoteRequest.description: A quote request: the pair, and the input size in base units.

amount_in.description: The input amount, in base units (a decimal integer string).

QuoteResponse.description:
A read-only quote: the routed split, its blended output, and price impact. `quote_id` is
deterministic from the request; `expires_at` is an advisory RFC-3339 instant (a quote does not
bind a future swap).

items.description:
One trade on the wire, header-only in a list; a detail also carries `lifecycle`, `legs`, and the
order's coordinates (omitted from JSON when absent). Assembled by the trade service.

deadline_block.description: Signed order expiry as Unix seconds.

decline_reason.description:
Why this trade declined — the admission rule, the sim gate's real on-chain revert reason,
or the margin call. Absent for a trade that has not declined.

oneOf.description:
What sourcing the delivery would have cost, gas included, in input-token units — present on
declined trades too, where it is the only account of why the resolver passed. Compare it to
`input` to read the shortfall.

input.description: The swapper's input token and the maximum it authorized.

legs.description: The maker slices the trade sourced — detail only.

order_hash.description: The signed order hash — detail only.

output.description: The output token and the amount delivered (or the signed floor, until it settles).

price_impact_pct.description: Price impact of the routed quote, in percent; absent when no route was found.

source.description: Where the order came from: `uniswapx` (the public book) or `solvent` (our own endpoint).

oneOf.description: Expected resolver profit from exact-out routing, net of estimated gas, in input-token units.

Side.description:
The trade direction a depth curve is plotted for; the pair's curves are asymmetric, so buying the
base and selling it hit different inventory and price differently.

Split.description: One token's share of a position's committed liquidity.

StrategyPrice.description: The strategy price after a transaction, or an unavailable price after docking/emptying.

SwapRequest.description:
A taker-signed order submission, mirroring the UniswapX Orders API (`{ encodedOrder, signature,
chainId, quoteId? }`). The taker's client builds + signs the base order; the server cosigns.

SwapResponse.description: The created trade and where its lifecycle stands (`created`…`submitted`, or `declined`).

Token.description:
A token's identity + display essentials — embedded wherever a response references a token
without the full [`Asset`] (pool base/quote, trade flows, roster).

TokenAmount.description: One token paired with an amount.

TokenAmounts.description: A set of token amounts (e.g. a strategy's per-token balances) with an optional USD total.

TokenBalance.description:
One token a wallet holds: its on-chain `balance` and the `pullable` amount a pull could take now
(`min(balance, allowance→settlement)`).

TradeAction.description: One lifecycle stage a trade reached, and when (unix seconds).
